name: smwgraphics-porky-pig-s-haunted-holiday-abandoned-inn
title: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday - Abandoned Inn
description:
A foreground tileset used in the abandoned inn at the end of the ghost town level from Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: This tileset works best if you use it in a layer 2 level with layer 2 scrolling set to constant.
